instruction:
In digital signal processing, a tuner is a circuit that can adjust the frequency of a signal. In this problem, you are given a Verilog module for a tuner that takes in a signed input of size `dsz` and a frequency input of size `fsz`. It also takes in a noise shaping enable signal `ns_ena` and has two outputs, `i_out` and `q_out`, both of size `dsz`.

The tuner module has two instances of a `tuner_slice_1k` module, one for `i_out` and one for `q_out`. The `tuner_slice_1k` module takes in the same inputs as the tuner module, as well as a `shf_90` signal which determines whether the slice produces a 90-degree phase-shifted output.

The tuner module has a phase accumulator that accumulates the frequency input `frq` on every positive edge of the clock signal `clk`. The accumulated value is stored in a register `acc` of size `fsz`.

The tuner module also has a noise shaping circuit that takes in the accumulated value `acc` and the noise shaping enable signal `ns_ena`. The noise shaping circuit has a noise shaping accumulator `ns_acc` of size `fsz` that accumulates the accumulated value `acc` and the noise shaping signal if `ns_ena` is high. The noise shaping signal is generated by shifting the `res` value of size `fsz-psz` in `ns_acc` to the left by `psz` bits and concatenating it with `psz` copies of the most significant bit of `res`. The `phs` output of size `psz` is the most significant `psz` bits of `ns_acc`, while the `res` output of size `fsz-psz` is the least significant `fsz-psz` bits of `ns_acc`.

Your task is to implement the `tuner_slice_1k` module that produces a slice of the tuner output. The `tuner_slice_1k` module should take in the same inputs as the tuner module, as well as a `shf_90` signal and a `phs` signal of size `psz`. The `tuner_slice_1k` module should produce an output `out` of size `dsz` that is the result of multiplying the input `in` by a sine wave at the frequency given by the accumulated value of `frq` and the phase given by the input `phs`, and then multiplying the result by a cosine wave if `shf_90` is high.
